newsitem.title: USA: Reno Air says Q3 advanced bookings strong.
newsitem.headline: Reno Air says Q3 advanced bookings strong.

text.p: Reno Air Inc said advanced bookings for the third quarter are strong and it expects its yield to outperform the year ago performance.
"Traditionally, the third quarter is our strongest financial quarter due to a heavy increase in vacation and leisure travel," Reno said.
Earlier on Tuesday, Reno posted second quarter earnings of $0.02 a share, down from $0.28 a share a year ago despite an increase in operating revenues.
Reno said limited availability of Pratt & Whitney spare engines used on its MD-80 aircraft hurt the second quarter results and fleet utilization and increased unit costs.
Operating costs per available seat mile increased to 8.3 cents in the second quarter of 1997 compared to 7.5 cents a year ago.
Shares of Reno Air dropped 1/4 to 8-3/8.
